## Hypothesis

The BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup captures a bullish edge when SPY reclaims a defined support level and the EMA ribbon flips bullish, allowing for a ride of the subsequent leg higher via the EMA ribbon as a dynamic trailing stop.

## Mechanism

The setup uses a combination of technical indicators, including the EMA ribbon, level reclaims, and confluence with multi-day or premarket structure, to identify potential bullish entries. The trigger requires at least two of the three conditions to fire simultaneously: level reclaim, EMA ribbon flip, and confluence with structure.
